testResults.name: workspace-cleo-coordinator
testResults.result: 8 tests passed for independent workspace databases, queued single-writer ownership, fencing, staging mutations, SQLite snapshots, ignore policy, idempotency, and crash recovery.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, Ruff format, and ty checks passed; tests never mutate FCA's real .cleo state.

decisions: Canonical mutations execute against disposable staging databases before atomic replacement.
Accepted and published journal records prevent logical mutation replay across crash windows.
limitations: Runtime composition must inject concrete CLEO initializer, executor, and publisher adapters.
